summary.headline: Index of the New Syntagma
summary.text: Index of chapters of the new astrological syntagma, listing chapters 1–25 on heavenly disposition, themes, zodiacal divisions, planetary allotments, trigons, depressions, terms, configurations, aspects, lunar twelfth-parts, conjunction, defluxion, stations, prorogator, additive, phases, diurnal stars, nodes, and rulership, with manuscript folio references.
